en.title: About the website requirements and designing
en.excerpt: Less is more, simple is more secure. 512 bytes is equal to 512 characters, this mean fast webpages. Static website with HTML 5, simple CSS integrated inside pages or CSS Grid Layout Module Level 2 for complex layouts for more flexibility and If needed JavaScript S6. Simple to edit, extremely fast without using databases, server-side render or scripts. With responsive website no need to use the mobile attribute. So no need to separate desktop and mobile website on different URLs. Privacy is actualy included too.
